tail:
Batch 53 has six A-page items and three B-page examples, with the manifest and proof contracts synchronized. The main results are the point-case A1 \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) action and the Jordan Hall regular module’s normalized Heisenberg Fock action. See the [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hall-algebras-and-tensor-categories/hall-algebra-modules-and-geometric-actions.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hall-algebras-and-tensor-categories/hall-algebra-modules-and-geometric-actions-examples.md), [Fock theorem](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-jordan-quiver-hall-module-realizes-normalized-heisenberg-fock-action.md), and [A1 action theorem](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-a1-nakajima-hecke-correspondence-gives-sl2-action.md).

The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-53.notes.md) record the plan/design conflict and handoff checks. The [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-53.proof-contracts.json), [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-53.coverage.json), and [cross-batch dependency record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-53.cross-batch-dependencies.json) are complete.

**Checks:** Precheck passed 7/7; proof layout passed with 22 steps and no defects; strict proof contracts passed 7/7; rendercheck passed on all 9 items and both pages; focused depcheck passed with no errors or warnings. Source fetch verified and stamped all 3 sources. Coverage check reported no errors, with one warning that Alpha must confirm the dispositions for the 12 unscaffolded results.

All nine Step 1 records are **escalated**: the required Green Hall A-page route remains a scaffold, and its planned supplier carriers are absent. The exact supplier IDs and hypotheses are in the cross-batch record. The run-wide item-level check also found 120 issues outside batch 53; all nine assigned levels match the recomputed graph. The batch-level check could not compare the graph because YAML parsing fails on 26 unrelated Information Theory items. A later content-policy retry likewise stopped on an unrelated missing item during repository inventory loading; an earlier focused run passed for all nine assigned items.

No shared plan, dependency artifact, engine state, or verdict was changed. These authoring records are not independent approval.
